title: Scaling limit of 1+1 dimensional directed polymer with power-law tail and spatial correlated noise
summary: We study a $(1+1)$-dimensional directed polymer in a spatially correlated random environment generated by power-law tail variables: $ω(i,x)=\sum_{y\in\mathbb Z}ψ_{y-x}ξ(i,y), ψ_y\sim λ_r |y|^{-r}, r\in(1/2,1)$, where the variables $ξ(i,y)$ are i.i.d. and have a regularly varying right tail with exponent $α>2$. The spatial covariance of the environment has long-range decay with Hurst parameter $H=\frac32-r\in(1/2,1)$.
